objective: Test whether pooled function-only core initialization helps Householder Mirror distill independently pretrained correlated ordinary MLP functions, beyond matched FiLM and rank-one codes.

worlds.mirror_positive: One independently pretrained common ordinary tanh 4->16->4 MLP, three dense teacher MLPs formed by algebraically exact Householder transformations (positive control only).
worlds.correlated_independent: Three ordinary tanh 4->16->4 MLPs trained from independent random initializations on targets 0.75*common_analytic(x, seed)+0.25*task_analytic(x,seed,rule). No shared or copied trained teacher weights.
worlds.unrelated_independent: Three ordinary tanh 4->16->4 MLPs trained from independent random initializations on distinct task_analytic(x,seed,rule).

teacher.model: Ordinary 4->16->4 tanh MLP (148 parameters); common model plus 3 correlated and 3 unrelated per seed; 7*5=35 distinct trained teacher models
teacher.source_functions: Deterministic random 12-unit tanh-plus-sine analytic function, seeded separately by task; teacher supervision only, no teacher weights to students
teacher.optimizer: AdamW(lr=0.012, weight_decay=0.0001), clip_norm=1, CPU FP32, torch_num_threads=1

student.matching: Mirror / FiLM / rank-one use same 148-parameter core and 3x16 rule codes = 196 floats; independent has 201 floats (3 ordinary width-7 MLPs); shared has 148 floats
student.mirror: Pre-/post-tanh Householder reflection by rule code with two rank-1 O(H) operations
student.rank1: Single rank-1 learned pre-tanh projection residual: tanh(u + 0.85*project_code(u)); no Householder post-transform
student.warm: 250 pooled train-label distillation updates of task-blind common MLP core followed by 500 task-aware updates with identical initial task codes; no teacher weights or oracle directions copied
student.cold: 750 task-aware updates; same physical shared core random initialization as pre-warm core; no pooled stage
student.optimizer: AdamW(lr=0.012, weight_decay=0.0001), clip_norm=1, batch=128, same indexed stream by world/seed for all arms
student.checkpoint_selection: DEV normalized MSE, at cumulative update 500 and 750; warm 250 pooled + (250 or 500) conditional; cold at 500 or 750 conditional
student.data_ranges: train/dev/fresh Uniform[-1,1]^4; OOD Uniform[-1.6,1.6]^4; different deterministic PRNG streams

experimental_design.student_information: Only teacher outputs (x, task ID, y); no teacher weights, oracle codes, or analytic formula
experimental_design.fresh_seal: Write all teacher and 120 student checkpoint SHA256 and protocol SHA256 in SEALED_TRAIN_MANIFEST.json before creating any fresh/OOD inputs; never use fresh for selection.

preregistered_gates.warmstart_optimization: In correlated_independent, mirror_warm Fresh NMSE at least 10% below mirror_cold in >=4/5 paired seeds
preregistered_gates.mirror_specific: In correlated_independent, mirror_warm Fresh NMSE at least 10% below BOTH film_warm and rank1_warm in >=4/5 paired seeds
preregistered_gates.deployment: No deployment advantage claim unless Mirror wins a measured quality/serialized-byte/train+inference-wall Pareto comparison; do not infer FLOPs equality from identical updates
preregistered_gates.generalization: Treat mirror_positive as aligned control, unrelated_independent as falsification; no natural-language/gpu/scaling claim from synthetic 4D experiments

accounting.teacher_pretrain: 35 teacher model training costs measured, separated from student comparison but reported
accounting.warm_pretrain: 250 pooled-core updates charged to each warm strategy even if one common initialization is re-used between warm arms
accounting.examples_seen: 750*128=96000 per student, including warm; teacher separately 700*128=89600 per teacher
accounting.compute: Report linear forward MAC/sample and training MAC proxy plus code ops separately, train CPU wall, batch1/batch128 forward us and torch.save packet bytes. Update matching is not exact FLOPs matching.
accounting.checkpoint_storage: Large binary training artifacts may remain outside git; manifest SHA256 and regeneration scripts committed.

environment: Container CPU PyTorch 2.10.0+cpu Python 3.13.5, FP32, single torch CPU thread, no GPU; record hardware details
integrity: Full per-seed paired results, SHA256 manifest, source tests, checkpoint replays, frozen verdicts including negative results. No changes to MA-1178/main.
